results.notes: TPOT with MTP enabled (54.84ms) is WORSE than non-MTP eager baseline (50.19ms). The assertion requires TPOT <= 100% of non-MTP TPOT. Actual ratio: 54.84/50.19 = 109.3% (9.3% higher, i.e., slower). MTP on MI100 underperforms because: (1) MTP is incompatible with HIP graph mode, forcing eager mode which loses graph benefits; (2) The draft model overhead is not compensated by the 85% acceptance rate. Graph mode alone provides 68-72% TPOT improvement (14.17ms vs 50.19ms) which MTP cannot match.
